text:
maria: RC for 0.18.0 blocked by typegen diff on JS SDK + sample-kit failing onboarding CI. Anyone looking?
ben: Link?
maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/17395 job 4 failing
maria: Snippet:
```
Error: type-hash mismatch
- export interface CreateWidget { name: string; description?: string; tags?: string[] }
+ export interface CreateWidget { description?: string; name: string; tags?: string[] }
```
ben: Property order changed in OpenAPI -> generated types reorder. Two options: enforce stable property sort in generator or pin previous typegen version.
rachel: Also semver guard blocked earlier because changelog flagged this as "minor". If we ship a patch to fix ordering, git checks will reject mismatch. We should fix changelog note to reflect a patch-level SDK parity fix.
ben: Plan: run local regen with stableSort, run sample-kit smoke, update package.json type-hash, and add changelog line "patch: SDK parity / regen stability fix". Will open PR shortly.
ci-bot: publish-gate: blocked by metadata mismatch. See report.
maria: Don't change API spec. Keep change confined to generator settings and changelog. Tag @rachel on PR for wording.
ben: Will push in ~10m and run `yarn tools:typegen --stableSort && yarn sample-kit:test` locally first.
rachel: If CI still flakes we may need release-ops exception, but try to avoid.
ci-bot: build queued for ben/regen-fix.
maria: Thanks — keep #release-war-room posted once green. :thumbsup:
